featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Old Woman’s Shoe (Mhatari Cha Boot) is located inside Kamla Nehru Park. It holds a special place for me because it was kind of a childhood dream—my mom always told me that I had seen it when I was very young, but I don’t remember it at all.

I recently visited just to see it again, but entry is allowed only for children below 12 years, so I couldn’t go inside. That was a little heartbreaking, especially because I really wanted to relive that childhood memory. Obviously, fitting inside isn’t possible now—and that’s okay.

Still, just visiting the place and seeing it after so many years felt nostalgic and special. Overall, it was a lovely experience revisiting a piece of my childhood.
